content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This is not a workaround. It’s a complete commerce infrastructure stack designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms fail. The core components are GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for Solana payment processing. Together, they form a system that automates product delivery the moment a payment confirms on-chain. You own the entire stack. No platform can shut you down. No fees beyond NOWPayments’ 0.5% charge. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% fee—on 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more per month. This is infrastructure sovereignty, not a temporary fix.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the stack operates: A customer lands on your GitHub Pages site, selects a product, and pays in Solana via NOWPayments. The payment triggers a webhook that fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. Cloudflare Workers handles the backend logic, verifying the payment and generating a secure download link. The order details are logged in Supabase, and the product file is served from Cloudflare R2. The entire process is automated, instantaneous, and secure. No manual intervention required. No buyer accounts needed. The customer pays, the system verifies, and the product delivers—all in under 10 seconds.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re in Nigeria, Kenya, Pakistan, or Venezuela, this is your solution. If you’re tired of platform restrictions, account freezes, or 10% fees, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who value ownership and control. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own the hosting, the backend logic, the order storage, and the payment processing. This is infrastructure designed to work in the hardest environments—pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and financial isolation.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—compared to Gumroad’s 10%. On 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more per month.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component serves a specific purpose: GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers executes the backend logic, ensuring payment verification and file delivery. Supabase stores order data securely, and Cloudflare R2 hosts your product files. NOWPayments processes Solana payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. These tools are chosen for their reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. Solana is recommended for its low transaction fees—under $0.10 per transaction. The stack is modular, meaning you can swap components as needed. For example, replace Supabase with Google Sheets or GitHub Pages with Cloudflare Pages. The architecture is flexible but always sovereign.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and step-by-step guides for every component. Alternatively, choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully deployed solution in 48 hours. If you prefer to build manually, begin with GitHub Pages for hosting, set up NOWPayments for Solana integration, and use Cloudflare Workers to automate delivery. Test each component individually before going live. The key is to deploy incrementally, ensuring each piece works as expected. Once live, monitor transactions via Supabase and optimize as needed. This is not a one-time setup—it’s a system you own and evolve.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for Solana payment processing. This architecture automates product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. No platform fees, no restrictions. You own the entire system. Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for blueprints and templates, or deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a turnkey solution in 48 hours.
Solana transactions cost under $0.10 each. This makes it ideal for low-value digital products like templates or presets.

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or digital downloads with crypto-only payments, the same architecture applies. Replace Solana with your preferred cryptocurrency—NOWPayments supports 300+ options. For a complete toolkit, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This is the fastest way to deploy a sovereign stack without building from scratch.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up NOWPayments for Solana integration. 3. Configure Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. 4. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 5. Host product files on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 6. Test the payment-to-delivery flow end-to-end. 7. Deploy incrementally, ensuring each component works. 8. Monitor transactions via Supabase and optimize as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step guides and templates. Alternatively, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully deployed solution in 48 hours.
What if Solana transaction fees rise?
Switch to another low-fee network like BSC or TRON. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, giving you flexibility.
Do customers need a Solana wallet to pay?
Yes, but NOWPayments simplifies the process. Customers pay directly from their wallet—no account creation required.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your NOWPayments dashboard. The system does not automate refunds, so set clear policies for your customers.
Can I scale this beyond 100 sales per month?
Absolutely. The stack is designed for scalability. Use the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for a scaling playbook and advanced configurations.
After deployment, you own the entire stack. No platform can shut you down. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
